fusions.name: Sun-Stored Bellow
fusions.desc: Breathes out a day of stored warmth in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 damage to everything in it. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Chew the Cud
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Spits a chewed wad that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Huddle Warmth
fusions.desc: Huddles your party into shared warmth: restores 3 health a second to you and every ally in your party for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Grazing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
